excerpt: CoinSwitch is a Bengaluru crypto trading app registered with FIU-India, offering spot, futures and options on 400+ coins. Founded in 2017.
content:
CoinSwitch is an Indian crypto investing and trading app. Its website lists spot trading, crypto futures and options settled in INR, Web3 coins, API trading, SmartInvest strategies, a monthly crypto SIP, crypto deposits and CoinSwitch Alpha for high-net-worth and institutional investors. It says it offers 400+ coins, that it is registered with the Financial Intelligence Unit - India (FIU-IND) and holds ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification, and that the app is trusted by 2 crore+ users.

The Block reported that CoinSwitch was founded in 2017 as a global aggregator of crypto exchanges and launched its India exchange operations through CoinSwitch Kuber in June 2020. Entrepreneur India names its cofounders as Ashish Singhal, Vimal Sagar Tiwari and Govind Soni, with Singhal as CEO. On 1 October 2026 it reported that CoinSwitch turned profitable on an adjusted EBITDA basis in FY26, with revenue up 150% to INR 324.19 crore and adjusted EBITDA of INR 86.38 crore.

In October 2021 CoinSwitch raised USD 260 million in a Series C round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Coinbase Ventures, with existing investors Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Sequoia Capital India and Tiger Global, at a valuation of USD 1.9 billion, according to The Block. At the time the company claimed more than 10 million users.

CoinSwitch's homepage describes its pricing as transparent and says API trading has zero fees, but it does not publish a fee table there; trading fees are shown in the app. Crypto is volatile and high-risk, and nothing on this page is investment advice. This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product for this page, and nothing here is paid placement.
